headline: Feed Box tips
title: Feed Box | Keep Base Pals Fed The Easy Way | Palworld Guide
video_script: Are your base Pals working slowly in Palworld one point zero? Hungry Pals walk to the Feed Box and eat on their own, so keep it stocked. You unlock it at Technology level four for twenty Wood. Cook your berries first. A Red Berry restores fifteen hunger, but a roasted one restores twenty one. Is your Feed Box full right now? Comment below!
description: The Feed Box in Palworld 1.0 unlocks at Technology level four, and cooked food like roasted berries restores more hunger than raw berries.
joke: Your Pals work hard, but they will never work for free berries.
